title: 🚫 Restricted and Prohibited Items: What Can’t Be Purchased or Shipped?
content:
Before buying products from China, please make sure the items can be purchased and shipped to your country.

Some products may be restricted or prohibited because of platform rules, logistics rules, customs regulations, safety concerns, or destination country laws.

This guide will help you understand which items may not be purchased or shipped, and what you should do before placing an order.


🌟 Simple overview

Not every product from China can be shipped internationally.

Some items are completely prohibited.
Some items can only be shipped through special routes.
Some items may require extra confirmation before purchase or shipping.

Before placing an order, please check whether your product is:

  • A normal item
  • A restricted item
  • A sensitive item
  • A prohibited item
  • A high-risk customs item

If you are not sure, please contact customer service before payment.


1. ⛔ What are prohibited items?

Prohibited items are items that cannot be purchased, stored, or shipped through our service.

These items may be rejected by our website, warehouse, logistics provider, customs, or local authorities.

Common prohibited items include:

  • Illegal drugs or controlled substances
  • Weapons, guns, ammunition, and explosives
  • Dangerous chemicals
  • Flammable or explosive products
  • Toxic or radioactive materials
  • Live animals or protected wildlife products
  • Cash, bank cards, securities, or financial documents
  • Counterfeit goods or illegal replicas
  • Illegal publications or restricted media
  • Products banned by Chinese law or destination country law

If your item is identified as prohibited, we may not be able to purchase it, store it, return it, or ship it.


2. ⚠️ What are restricted items?

Restricted items are not always completely banned, but they may have special shipping limits.

These items may need:

  • Special shipping routes
  • Manual review
  • Extra packaging
  • Extra documents
  • Higher shipping fees
  • Longer delivery time
  • Customs approval
  • Destination country confirmation

Common restricted items include:

  • Food
  • Snacks
  • Tea
  • Coffee
  • Cosmetics
  • Liquids
  • Creams
  • Powders
  • Perfume
  • Batteries
  • Electronic products with batteries
  • Magnetic items
  • Medicines
  • Supplements
  • Branded products
  • Fragile items
  • Oversized items
  • Heavy items

Restricted items may not be accepted by all shipping methods.


3. 🔋 Battery and electronic products

Battery products and electronic products may have shipping restrictions.

Examples include:

  • Power banks
  • Lithium batteries
  • Wireless earphones
  • Bluetooth speakers
  • Smart watches
  • Electronic toys
  • Electric tools
  • Products with built-in batteries
  • Products with detachable batteries

Some battery products can be shipped through special routes, while others may not be accepted.

Before buying battery-related products, please contact customer service and provide the product link, battery type, quantity, and destination country.


4. 🧴 Liquids, creams, and cosmetics

Liquid and cream products may be restricted by many shipping methods.

Examples include:

  • Shampoo
  • Lotion
  • Skincare products
  • Makeup products
  • Nail polish
  • Perfume
  • Essential oils
  • Cleaning liquids
  • Glue
  • Ink
  • Paint

Some routes may not accept liquids at all. Other routes may accept them only in small quantities or with special packaging.

Please confirm with customer service before purchasing these products.


5. 🧂 Powders and food products

Powder and food products may face customs restrictions.

Examples include:

  • Milk powder
  • Protein powder
  • Seasoning powder
  • Medicine powder
  • Skincare powder
  • Snacks
  • Tea
  • Coffee
  • Dried food
  • Health food

Different countries have different import rules for food and powder items. Some countries may reject, inspect, delay, return, or destroy such parcels.

Please confirm before placing an order.


6. 💊 Medicines and supplements

Medicines, health products, and supplements may be strictly controlled by destination countries.

Examples include:

  • Prescription medicine
  • Chinese medicine
  • Vitamins
  • Health supplements
  • Capsules
  • Tablets
  • Medical devices
  • Personal treatment products

Some of these items may not be accepted by our logistics routes. Even if they can be shipped, they may still be inspected or rejected by customs.

Please do not purchase medical or health-related products without confirming the shipping rules first.


7. 🏷️ Branded goods and replica products

Branded goods may have customs risks, especially if the product involves trademark, copyright, or authenticity concerns.

Examples include:

  • Luxury brand bags
  • Branded shoes
  • Branded clothes
  • Designer accessories
  • Sports brand products
  • Watches
  • Fashion replicas
  • Products with famous logos

Counterfeit or illegal replica products are not supported.

Even for genuine branded goods, some shipping routes may not accept them, and customs inspection risk may be higher.

Please contact customer service before purchasing branded items.


8. 🧲 Magnetic items

Magnetic items may affect air transportation and may require special handling.

Examples include:

  • Speakers
  • Headphones
  • Magnets
  • Magnetic phone holders
  • Motors
  • Some electronic devices
  • Some toys

Some logistics routes may reject magnetic items or require a special route.

Please confirm before shipping.


9. 🧨 Fragile or easily damaged items

Fragile items may be allowed, but they require extra care.

Examples include:

  • Glass products
  • Ceramic products
  • Lamps
  • Mirrors
  • Figurines
  • Collectibles
  • Screens
  • Electronic devices
  • Musical instruments

For fragile items, we recommend choosing reinforcement, waterproof packaging, or extra protection if available.

Please note that international shipping involves multiple handling stages. Even with careful packaging, there is still a risk of damage.


10. 📏 Oversized or overweight items

Large or heavy items may not be accepted by some shipping methods.

Examples include:

  • Furniture
  • Large storage boxes
  • Large toys
  • Fitness equipment
  • Lamps
  • Home appliances
  • Long or irregular-shaped items
  • Large rolls of fabric
  • Oversized decorations

Oversized items may have:

  • Higher shipping fees
  • Volume weight charges
  • Fewer available shipping methods
  • Longer processing time
  • Special handling fees

Before buying oversized products, please contact customer service and confirm whether they can be shipped to your country.


11. 🌍 Destination country restrictions

Each country has its own import rules.

The same product may be allowed in one country but restricted in another.

For example:

  • Some countries have strict food import rules
  • Some countries restrict medicine or supplements
  • Some countries inspect branded goods more often
  • Some countries limit battery products
  • Some countries require tax ID or customs documents
  • Some countries may reject certain materials or product categories

Please check your local import rules before buying special items.


12. 📦 What happens if I buy a restricted item?

If your item is restricted, several things may happen:

  • The order may need manual review
  • Customer service may contact you for confirmation
  • Some shipping methods may not be available
  • You may need to choose a special shipping route
  • Shipping fee may be higher
  • Delivery time may be longer
  • The item may be rejected by the logistics provider
  • The item may need to be returned to the Chinese seller
  • The item may be delayed, returned, or held by customs

If the item cannot be shipped, we will help you check the available options based on the actual situation.


13. 🔄 What happens if the item cannot be shipped?

If the item has already arrived at our warehouse but cannot be shipped internationally, possible solutions may include:

  • Return the item to the Chinese seller
  • Exchange it for another item
  • Change to another available shipping method
  • Ship it to a different address, if possible
  • Store it temporarily in the warehouse
  • Dispose of it according to warehouse rules, if no other option is available

Please note that return shipping fees, seller rejection, service fees, storage fees, or other costs may apply depending on the situation.


14. ✅ How to check before buying

Before placing an order, we recommend checking the item carefully.

Please contact customer service if the item includes:

  • Battery
  • Liquid
  • Powder
  • Food
  • Medicine
  • Supplements
  • Perfume
  • Cosmetics
  • Magnetic parts
  • Famous brand logos
  • Fragile materials
  • Oversized packaging
  • Dangerous materials
  • Anything you are unsure about

To help us confirm faster, please provide:

  • Product link
  • Product photo or screenshot
  • Product name
  • Quantity
  • Destination country
  • Preferred shipping method, if any


15. 📝 User responsibility

Please make sure the product information you provide is accurate.

Do not hide or change the real product type.

For example, please do not describe perfume as “daily goods,” batteries as “accessories,” or branded replicas as “normal clothes.”

Incorrect product information may cause:

  • Logistics rejection
  • Customs delay
  • Parcel return
  • Parcel confiscation
  • Extra fees
  • Failed compensation
  • Account restriction

We reserve the right to refuse orders or parcels that may violate laws, shipping rules, customs regulations, or platform policies.


Important notes

  • Not all products from China can be shipped internationally.
  • Prohibited items cannot be purchased or shipped through our service.
  • Restricted items may require special routes or manual confirmation.
  • Different countries and shipping methods have different rules.
  • Sensitive items may cost more and take longer to deliver.
  • Customs inspection risk may be higher for restricted items.
  • If an item cannot be shipped due to product restrictions, extra fees may apply.
  • Please contact customer service before buying any uncertain item.


Frequently Asked Questions

Q1: Can I buy products with batteries?

Some battery products can be shipped through special routes, but not all routes accept them. Please contact customer service before purchasing.

Q2: Can I ship cosmetics?

Some cosmetics can be shipped, but liquids, creams, powders, and perfumes may be restricted. Shipping availability depends on the destination country and route.

Q3: Can I ship food or snacks?

Food products are restricted in many countries. Some routes may not accept them. Please confirm before buying.

Q4: Can I ship branded products?

Branded products may have customs risks. Counterfeit or illegal replica products are not supported. Please confirm with customer service before purchasing branded items.

Q5: What if I already bought an item that cannot be shipped?

Please contact customer service as soon as possible. We will help you check whether the item can be returned, exchanged, stored, or shipped through another route.

Q6: Can I choose any shipping method for restricted items?

No. Restricted items may only be accepted by certain shipping methods. Some routes may not support them at all.

Q7: Who is responsible if customs rejects the parcel?

Customs decisions are made by the destination country. If a parcel is rejected, returned, confiscated, or taxed due to product restrictions, local laws, or incorrect declaration, the related costs may need to be paid by the user.


Need help?

If you are not sure whether an item can be purchased or shipped, please contact our customer service team before placing your order.

To help us check faster, please provide:

  • Product link
  • Product screenshot
  • Product name
  • Quantity
  • Destination country
  • Whether the item contains battery, liquid, powder, food, medicine, or brand logos

We will help you check the possible shipping options before you pay.
